newsitem.title: USA: Harleysville posts record qtrly earnings.
newsitem.headline: Harleysville posts record qtrly earnings.

text.p: Harleysville National Corp Friday posted record quarterly earnings of $4.4 million, or $0.62 a share, compared with $3.6 million, or $0.52 a share, the year before.
"We are encouraged by the strong economy," said chief executive Walter Daller in a statement. "Continued attention to overhead ratios and asset quality should serve us well going forward."
The bank's non-performing assets stood at $6.3 million, or 0.6 percent of total assets, at June 30, compared with $12.7 million, or 1.3 percent of total assets a year ago.
The bank's return on average assets increased to 1.64 percent in the second quarter, compared with 1.51 percent the year before.
Harleysville National is the parent of Harleysville National Bank and Trust Co, The Citizens National Bank of Lansford, Security National Bank and HNC Financial Co.
Harleysville's stock hit an intra-day 52-week high Friday morning but later traded at 33, down 1/8.
